about: The official OpenAI text-token price table that every gpt-* row of DEFAULT_PRICING (src/usage-history.js) is judged against by scripts/test-pricing-openai.mjs. USD per 1M tokens, Standard tier. Read from the RAW HTML of the pages below (the pricing page's embedded table data + each model page's 'Text tokens' block), not a summary. When OpenAI changes a price: re-fetch, update this file AND the row together, and move the old rate into the row's `earlier` list (and `dated` here) if ledger rows were billed at it. cacheWrite null = the page lists no cache-write rate (5.5 and older). long = the >272K-input-token rate for the WHOLE request; longSource says whether the page prints it or it is the page's stated multiplier applied ('2x input and 1.5x output'; the doubled cached rate is printed only for gpt-6-astra and gpt-5.6-sol).

gpt-5.6-terra.longSource: model page multiplier (2x input, 1.5x output, full request)

gpt-5.6-luna.longSource: model page multiplier (2x input, 1.5x output, full request)

gpt-5.5.longSource: model page multiplier ('For GPT-5.5, prompts with >272K input tokens are priced at 2x input and 1.5x output for the full session')

gpt-5.4.longSource: model page multiplier ('For models with a 1.05M context window (GPT-5.4 and GPT-5.4 Pro) … 2x input and 1.5x output')
